We need to use integration by parts. We'll work out the indefinite integral first, and then proceed to work out the definite integral.

In this case, we define

$$
\begin{aligned}u={t}^{2}\, & ⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t}=2t, \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}={e}^{4t}\, & ⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}\,\text{d}t=\int {e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t=\frac{1}{4}{e}^{4t}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the formula of integration by parts, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int {t}^{2}{e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}\,\text{d}t \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t}\,\text{d}t \\  & =({t}^{2})(\frac{1}{4}{e}^{4t})-\int (\frac{1}{4}{e}^{4t})(2t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{t}^{2}{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{2}\int t{e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

We use integration by parts once again to evaluate $\int t{e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t.$ We take

$$
\begin{aligned}u=t\, & ⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t}=1, \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}={e}^{4t}\, & ⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}\,\text{d}t=\int {e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t=\frac{1}{4}{e}^{4t}.\end{aligned}
$$

In this case, the formula for integration by parts gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\int t{e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}\,\text{d}t \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t}\,\text{d}t \\  & =(t)(\frac{1}{4}{e}^{4t})-\int (\frac{1}{4}{e}^{4t})(1)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1}{4}t{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{4}\int {e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1}{4}t{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{16}{e}^{4t}+D,\end{aligned}
$$

where $D$ is a constant. 

So, we get that the indefinite integral is

$$
\begin{aligned}\int {t}^{2}{e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t & =\frac{1}{4}{t}^{2}{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{2}\int t{e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{t}^{2}{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{2}(\frac{1}{4}t{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{16}{e}^{4t}+D) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{t}^{2}{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{8}t{e}^{4t}+\frac{1}{32}{e}^{4t}+C,\end{aligned}
$$

where $C=-\frac{D}{2}.$

Finally, we can work out the definite integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{t}^{2}{e}^{4t}\,\text{d}t & =(\frac{1}{4}{t}^{2}{e}^{4t}-\frac{1}{8}t{e}^{4t}+\frac{1}{32}{e}^{4t})\,{|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =(\frac{1}{4}({1}^{2}){e}^{4}-\frac{1}{8}(1){e}^{4}+\frac{1}{32}{e}^{4})-(\frac{1}{4}({0}^{2}){e}^{0}-\frac{1}{8}(0){e}^{0}+\frac{1}{32}{e}^{0}) \\  & =\frac{5}{32}{e}^{4}-\frac{1}{32} \\  & =\frac{5{e}^{4}-1}{32}\end{aligned}
$$
